speeches.text: Be mindful of thy safety.

speeches.speaker: ANTONIO
speeches.text: Necessity compels me : Make scrutiny through the passages Of your own life, you'll find it impossible To fly your fate.

speeches.speaker: ECHO
speeches.text: 0, fly your fate!

speeches.speaker: DELIO
speeches.text: Hark! the dead stones seem to have pity on you, And give you good counsel.

speeches.speaker: ANTONIO
speeches.text: Echo, I will not talk with thee, For thou art a dead thing.

speeches.speaker: ECHO
speeches.text: Thou art a dead thing.

speeches.speaker: ANTONIO
speeches.text: My duchess is asleep now, And her little ones, I hope sweetly : O heaven, Shall I never see her more ?

speeches.speaker: ECHO
speeches.text: Never see her more.

speeches.speaker: ANTONIO
speeches.text: I mark'd not one repetition of the echo But that ; and on the sudden a clear light Presented me a face folded in sorrow.

speeches.speaker: DELIO
speeches.text: Your fancy merely.

speeches.speaker: ANTONIO
speeches.text: Come, I '11 be out of this ague, For to live thus is not indeed to live ; It is a mockery and abuse of life : I will not henceforth save myself by halves ; Lose all, or nothing.

speeches.speaker: DELIO
speeches.text: Your own virtue save you ! I '11 fetch your eldest son, and second you : It may be that the sight of his own blood Spread in so sweet a figure may beget The more compassion. However, fare you well. Though in our miseries Fortune have a part, Yet in our noble sufferings she hath none : Contempt of pain, that we may call our own.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: You shall not watch to-night by the sick prince ; His grace is very well recovered.

speeches.speaker: MALATESTI
speeches.text: Good my lord, suffer us.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: O, by no means ; The noise, and change of object in his eye, Doth more distract him : I pray, all to bed ; And though you hear him in his violent fit, Do not rise, I entreat you.

speeches.speaker: PESCARA
speeches.text: So, sir ; we shall not.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Nay, I must have you promise Upon your honours, for I was enjoin'd to 't By himself ; and he seem'd to urge it sensibly.

speeches.speaker: PESCARA
speeches.text: Let our honours bind this trifle.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Nor any of your followers.

speeches.speaker: MALATESTI
speeches.text: Neither.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: It may be, to make trial of your promise, When he 's asleep, myself will rise and feign Some of his mad tricks, and cry out for help, And feign myself in danger.

speeches.speaker: MALATESTI
speeches.text: If your throat were cutting, I ;d not come at you, now I have protested against it.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Why, I thank you.

speeches.speaker: GRISOLAN
speeches.text: 'Twas a foul storm to-night.

speeches.speaker: RODERIGO
speeches.text: The Lord Ferdinand's chamber shook like an osier.

speeches.speaker: MALATESTI
speeches.text: 'Twas nothing but pure kindness in the devil To rock his own child.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: The reason why I would not suffer these About my brother, is, because at midnight I may with better privacy convey Julia's body to her own lodging. O, my conscience ! I would pray now ; but the devil takes away my heart For having any confidence in prayer. About this hour I appointed Bosola To fetch the body : when he hath serv'd my turn, He dies.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Ha ! 'twas the cardinal's voice ; I heard him name Bosola and my death. Listen ; I hear one's footing.

speeches.speaker: FERDINAND
speeches.text: Strangling is a very quiet death.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Nay, then, I see I must stand upon my guard.

speeches.speaker: FERDINAND
speeches.text: What say [you] to that ? whisper softly ; do you agree to Jt ? So ; it must be done i' the dark : the cardinal would not for a thousand pounds the doctor should see it

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: My death is plotted ; here 5s the consequence of murder. We value not desert nor Christian breath, When we know black deeds must be cur'd with death.

speeches.speaker: SERVANT
speeches.text: Here stay, sir, and be confident, I pray : I '11 fetch you a dark lantern.

speeches.speaker: ANTONIO
speeches.text: Could I take him at his prayers, There were hope of pardon.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Fall right, my sword ! — I '11 not give thee so much leisure as to pray.

speeches.speaker: ANTONIO
speeches.text: O, I am gone ! Thou hast ended a long suit In a minute.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: What art thou?

speeches.speaker: ANTONIO
speeches.text: A most wretched thing, That only have thy benefit in death, To appear myself.

speeches.speaker: SERVANT
speeches.text: Where are you, sir ?

speeches.speaker: ANTONIO
speeches.text: Very near my home. — Bosola !

speeches.speaker: SERVANT
speeches.text: O, misfortune !

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Smother thy pity, thou art dead else.— Antonio ! The man I would have sav'd 'bove mine own life I re are merely the stars' tennis-balls, struck and banded Which way please them. — O good Antonio, I '11 whisper one thing in thy dying ear Shall make thy heart break quickly ! thy fair duchess And two sweet children

speeches.speaker: ANTONIO
speeches.text: Their very names Kindle a little life in me.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Are murder'd.

speeches.speaker: ANTONIO
speeches.text: Some men have wish'd to die At the hearing of sad tidings ; I am glad That I shall do Jt in sadness : I would not now Wish my wounds balm'd nor heal'd, for I have no use To put my life to. In all our quest of greatness, Like wanton boys whose pastime is their care, We follow after bubbles blown in the air. Pleasure of life, what is 't ? only the good hours Of an ague ; merely a preparative to rest, \( To endure vexation. I do not ask The process of my death ; only commend me To Delio.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Break, heart!

speeches.speaker: ANTONIO
speeches.text: And let my son fly the courts of princes.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Thou seem'st to have lov'd Antonio.

speeches.speaker: SERVANT
speeches.text: I brought him hither, To have reconcil'd him to the cardinal.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: I do not ask thee that Take him up, if thou tender thine own life, And bear him where the lady Julia Was wont to lodge.— O, my fate moves swift ! I have this cardinal in the forge already ; Now I '11 bring him to the hammer. O direful misprision ! I will not imitate things glorious, No more than base ; I '11 be mine own example. - On, on, and look thou represent, for silence, The thing thou bar'st

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: I am puzzled in a question about hell ; He says, in hell there 's one material fire, And yet it shall not burn all men alike. Lay him by. How tedious is a guilty conscience ! When I look into the fish-ponds in my garden, Methinks I see a thing arm'd with a rake, That seems to strike at me. Now, art thou come ? Thou look'st ghastly : There sits in thy face some great determination Mix'd with some fear. I j

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Thus it lightens into action : I am come to kill thee.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Ha ! — Help ! our guard

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Thou art deceiv'd ; They are out of thy howling.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Hold ; and I will faithfully divide Revenues with thee.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Thy prayers and proffers Are both unseasonable.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Raise the watch ! we are betray'd !

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: I have confm'd your flight : I '11 suffer your retreat to Julia's chamber, But no further.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Help ! we are betray'd !

speeches.speaker: MALATESTI
speeches.text: Listen.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: My dukedom for rescue I

speeches.speaker: RODERIGO
speeches.text: Fie upon his counterfeiting

speeches.speaker: MALATESTI
speeches.text: Why, 'tis not the cardinal.

speeches.speaker: RODERIGO
speeches.text: Yes, yes, 'tis he : But, I '11 see him hang'd ere I '11 go down to him.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Here 's a plot upon me ; I am assaulted ! I am lost, Unless some rescue !

speeches.speaker: GRISOLAN
speeches.text: He doth this pretty well ; But it will not serve to laugh me out of mine honour.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: The sword 's at my throat !

speeches.speaker: RODERIGO
speeches.text: You would not bawl so loud then.

speeches.speaker: MALATESTI
speeches.text: Come, come, let 's go To bed : he told us this much aforehand.

speeches.speaker: PESCARA
speeches.text: He wish'd you should not come at him; but, believe 't, The accent of the voice sounds not in jest : I '11 down to him, howsoever, and with engines Force ope the doors.

speeches.speaker: RODERIGO
speeches.text: Let 's follow him aloof, And note how the cardinal will laugh at him.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: There 's for you first, 'Cause you shall not unbarricade the door To let in rescue.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: What cause hast thou to pursue my life ?

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Look there.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Antonio!

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Slain by my hand unwittingly. Pray, and be sudden : when thou kill'd'st thy sister, Thou took'st from Justice her most equal balance, And left her naught but her sword.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: O, mercy !

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Now it seems thy greatness was only outward ; For thou fall'st faster of thyself than calamity Can drive thee. I '11 not waste longer time ; there !

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Thou hast hurt me.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Again !

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Shall I die like a leveret, Without any resistance?— Help, help, help ! I am slain !

speeches.speaker: FERDINAND
speeches.text: The alarum ! give me a fresh horse ; I Rally the vaunt-guard, or the day is lost, Yield, yield ! I give you the honour of arms Shake my sword over you ; will you yield?

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Help me ; I am your brother I

speeches.speaker: FERDINAND
speeches.text: The devil ! My brother fight upon the adverse party ! There flies your ransom.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: O justice ! I suffer now for what hath former bin : Sorrow is held the eldest child of sin.

speeches.speaker: FERDINAND
speeches.text: Now you 're brave fellows. Caesar's fortune was harder than Pompey's ; Caesar died in the arms of prosperity, Pompey at the feet of disgrace. You both died in the field. The pain 's nothing : pain many times is taken away with the apprehension of greater, as the tooth-ache with the sight of a barber that comes to pull it out : there 's philosophy for you.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Now my revenge is perfect. — Sink, thou main cause Of my undoing ! — The last part of my life Hath done me best service.

speeches.speaker: FERDINAND
speeches.text: Give me some wet hay ; I am broken-winded. I do account this world but a dog-kennel : I will vault credit and affect high pleasures Beyond death.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: He seems to come to himself, Now he 's so near the bottom.

speeches.speaker: FERDINAND
speeches.text: My sister, O my sister ! there 's the cause on 't. Whether we fall by ambition, blood, or lust, Like diamonds, we are cut with our own dust.

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Thou hast thy payment too.

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Yes, I hold my weary soul in my teeth ; 'Tis ready to part from me. I do glory That thou, which stood'st like a huge pyramid Begun upon a large and ample base, Shalt end in a little point, a kind of nothing.

speeches.speaker: PESCARA
speeches.text: How now, my lord !

speeches.speaker: MALATESTI
speeches.text: O sad disaster !

speeches.speaker: RODERIGO
speeches.text: How comes this ?

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: Revenge for the Duchess of Malfi murder'd By the Arragonian brethren ; for Antonio Slain by this hand ; for lustful Julia Poison'd by this man ; and lastly for myself, That was an actor in the main of all Much 'gainst mine own good nature, yet i' the end Neglected.

speeches.speaker: PESCARA
speeches.text: How now, my lord !

speeches.speaker: CARDINAL
speeches.text: Look to my brother : He gave us these large wounds, as we were struggling Here i' the rushes. And now, I pray, let me Be laid by and never thought of.

speeches.speaker: PESCARA
speeches.text: How fatally, it seems, he did withstand His own rescue !

speeches.speaker: MALATESTI
speeches.text: Thou wretched thing of blood, How came Antonio by his death ?

speeches.speaker: BOSOLA
speeches.text: In a mist ; I know not how : Such a mistake as I have often seen In a play. O, I am gone ! We are only like dead walls or vaulted graves, That, ruin'd, yield no echo. Fare you well. It may be pain, but no harm, to me to die In so good a quarrel. O, this gloomy world ! In what a shadow, or deep pit of darkness, Doth womanish and fearful mankind live ! Let worthy minds ne'er stagger in distrust To suffer death or shame for what is just : Mine is another voyage.

speeches.speaker: PESCARA
speeches.text: The noble Delio, as I came to the palace, Told me of Antonio's being here, and show'd me A pretty gentleman, his son and heir.

speeches.speaker: MALATESTI
speeches.text: O sir, you come too late !

speeches.speaker: DELIO
speeches.text: I heard so, and Was arm'd for't, ere I came. Let us make noble use Of this great ruin ; and join all our force To establish this young hopeful gentleman In 3s mother's right. These wretched eminent things Leave no more fame behind 'em, than should one Fall in a frost, and leave his print in snow ; As soon as the sun shines, it ever melts, Both form and matter. I have ever thought Nature doth nothing so great for great men As when she 's pleas'd to make them lords of truth : Integrity of life is fame's best friend, Which nobly, beyond death, shall crown the end.
